successors.name: Niger Coast Protectorate
successors.text: Bonny, under a protectorate treaty of February 1886 ('in 1886 assuming control under a protectorate treaty')

successors.name: Kingdom of Opobo
successors.text: Opobo, founded by Jaja after the 1869 battle in Bonny

ledger.x: c. 1000: the Bonny kingdom. 'The kingdom was founded before or about 1000 AD' at Orupiri on Bonny Island; Alagbariya is named as founder. The page's dating is a tradition; 'Bonny became important in the 15th century with the arrival of the Portuguese'.
1886 (February): sovereign Bonny ends; the kingdom continues as a traditional state (Edward Asimini William Dappa Pepple III took the throne in 1996).

wars.name: Bonny civil war and the founding of Opobo
wars.outcome: A major battle between the two factions in 1869 led to Jaja founding Opobo; British intervention in 1873 and 1882.
